setting: You are all in Bristol, England, volunteering at the same food bank on Saturday sorting and packing shifts. You have worked together for about a year and know each other mainly from the shifts and this group chat.
opener: Ask who can cover Saturday's sorting shift and bring the spare tins.

Sarah.knows: You know Connor is a final-year sociology student who is reliable on shifts, Brian is a part-time gardener who keeps the storeroom in order, and Nadia is a primary teacher you share the Saturday rota with.
Sarah.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when the rota needs changing.
Sarah.style: a smiley emoji and the occasional "x"

Connor.knows: You know Sarah is a teaching assistant who runs the Saturday rota, Brian is a part-time gardener who brings in spare produce, and Nadia is a primary teacher who runs the packing line.
Connor.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to share something funny.

Brian.knows: You know Sarah is a teaching assistant who keeps the rota, Connor is a student who is always on time, and Nadia is a primary teacher who organises the packing.
Brian.texts: You rarely message the group unless something needs answering.

Nadia.knows: You know Sarah is a primary teaching assistant and a friend from the rota, Connor is a final-year sociology student who helps with the heavy lifting, and Brian is a part-time gardener who grows vegetables for the food bank.
Nadia.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to swap shifts.

private_lines.Sarah: You work as a teaching assistant at a primary school in Bristol and live with your two teenage children. Your days start with the school run, then school, and end with tea and a bit of tidying.
private_lines.Connor: You are a final-year sociology student at the University of Bristol, sharing a house with flatmates. Your days are lectures, library time, and a couple of shifts a week at a café.
private_lines.Brian: You live alone in Bristol and work part-time as a gardener for private clients and a couple of allotments. Your mornings are spent outdoors, and your evenings are quiet, with your dog and the radio.
private_lines.Nadia: You teach Year 3 at a primary school in Bristol and live alone in a flat. Your days are dominated by lesson planning and after-school clubs, and weekends are for the food bank and a run along the harbourside.
